record.question: Which of the following is true about The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
options: The Act has bypassed the Constitutional Local Self Government by not recognizing them as 'appropriate government' in matters of land acquisition

The Act focuses on providing not only compensation to the land owners but also extends rehabilitation and resettlement benefits to livelihood loser from the land in addition to the minimum compensation

Under the Act land can be acquired by the Government for housing for such income groups as may be specified from time to time by the appropriate government and for private bodies also for certain purpose
All of the above are true
